objective: Implement the bounded Campaign Activity/downtime integration from APW-03: a durable Campaign-scoped orchestration layer for alpha-useful between-Session work while keeping every authoritative Character, Action, Asset/economy, investigation, social, World/Adventure and Campaign effect in its existing owning domain.
implementation_outcome: Live inspection proved the downtime-projects public contract/schema roots contained only ownership placeholders and Stage A A8 explicitly recorded that long-running D26 Project timing/research was not implemented, so the actual next additive migration 0011 was required.

Migration 0011 adds only D26/D26_REFERENCE_ONLY Campaign Activity, task, operation and external-reference records; it does not move A6, A8, A9, progression, Campaign, World or Adventure truth into D26.

Campaign Activity exposes the seven APW-03 resolution classes: informational, immediate-domain-command, proposal-required, timed-project-progress, human-choice-required, gm-adjudication-required and prohibited.
A8 Asset reservations are acquired and released only through the existing AssetReservationPort; D26 stores reservation/result/Event references rather than inventory/economy truth.
Non-untimed progress requires explicit Campaign-time evidence; elapsed wall-clock time has no Campaign-time authority.
Human choice, irreversible advancement and GM adjudication/reveal remain explicit hard stops; D26 never infers consent, advancement or hidden information.
Visibility filtering precedes list/cardinality projection; private Campaign Activities are omitted for unauthorized viewers.
Stable operation identity excludes retry observation time, stale expected versions fail closed and recovery returns prior operation/activity state without duplicate work.
The local service is a deterministic local-alpha/CI harness and the bounded workflow remains manual/no-AI capable.
